title: 4A Full Adhesive Sticky Notes, 3 x 5 Inches, 5 Assorted Colors, 5 Pads, 60 Sheets per Pad, 300 Sheets Total
bullets: 5 pads, 300 sheets total: Includes 5 assorted-color pads with 60 sheets per pad. Each rectangular note measures 3 x 5 inches.
Full-adhesive design with a lifting edge: A wide adhesive area covers the back, with a non-stick edge to help separate one sheet from the pad.
Five assorted colors: Separate colors help organize subjects, tasks and reminders. Refer to the product images for the five colors included in this pack.
Write, lift and place: Start at the non-stick edge and separate one sheet gently. Apply to a clean, dry surface and test delicate finishes or printed pages before use.
For notes and color coding: Use the paper sheets for reminders, study annotations, sorting and everyday planning at home, school or the office. Pens and other scene accessories are not included.
description: Organize everyday reminders with 4A full-adhesive sticky notes. Each 3 x 5 inch rectangular sheet provides space for notes, annotations and color coding. This pack contains five assorted-color pads, with 60 sheets per pad and 300 sheets total. The back has a wide adhesive area and a non-stick lifting edge for separating sheets. Test delicate surfaces and printed pages before applying. Paper note pads only; scene accessories are not included.
